import pytest

from tomlkit.exceptions import KeyAlreadyPresent
from tomlkit.exceptions import TOMLKitError
from tomlkit import parse


def test_value_then_table_redefinition_out_of_order_raises_at_parse() -> None:
    """
    Test that an out-of-order value-vs-table redefinition raises KeyAlreadyPresent
    at parse time, not lazily on access.
    """
    src = '[a]\nb = true\n[zz]\n[a.b]\nc = 1\n'
    with pytest.raises(KeyAlreadyPresent):
        parse(src)


def test_dotted_key_then_table_redefinition_out_of_order_raises_at_parse() -> None:
    """
    Test that an out-of-order dotted-key-vs-table redefinition raises KeyAlreadyPresent
    at parse time, not silently merging.
    """
    src = '[a]\nb.c = 1\n[zz]\nq = 9\n[a.b]\nd = 2\n'
    with pytest.raises(KeyAlreadyPresent):
        parse(src)
